taskDescription:
I want a script that can be used to convert a mermaid diagram to an image that can be sent to the user who is on their phone in the remote control. this way they can see the plan diagram. 

1. figure out how to make this script that converts a mermaid diagram to an image. make unit tests
2. figure out how to call this script on the diagram in the plan files
3. update the planning agent to show the user the image
